who.value: Buyer or seller considering a Carousell Plus subscription

job.value: Pick a Monthly or Yearly Plus plan and subscribe

arrivedFrom.value: A 'Go ad-free with Carousell Plus!' banner or the sidebar

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Subscribe to Carousell Plus' with 'With Carousell Plus you get:' says what the page is.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The Monthly/Yearly cards start at the bottom of the first screen and their subscribe buttons are cut off; the benefit list takes the space.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Monthly', 'Yearly', 'Recommended' and '2 months free' each say what they mean.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Expanded saved searches' and 'Priority customer support' are explained inline.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Monthly vs yearly is a choice the person can make from the prices shown ('S$0.99/month for first 2 months', 'S$19.99/year').

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: All five benefits come with full explanatory clauses before the plans, e.g. 'to track up to 30 items by saving the search & getting notification…'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: An 'Advertisement' slot sits beside a page whose first benefit is 'Ad-free browsing'.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The bolded benefit names help, but five long benefit sentences come before the plan choice.
